bearer.description: An OAuth access token or a personal access token, in the Authorization header; for contract.report, a GitHub Actions OIDC token. Each operation lists the scopes its token needs.

info.description: The REST API of a Tiehall install, under /api/v1. It is beta: each operation carries its stability level, and breaking changes follow the notice rules on the changelog page at /docs/api/changelog.
info.title: Tiehall API
